description: This file defines the DOMSettingsUnmarshaller class responsible for deserializing XML configuration data into Settings objects within the RomRaider project. It includes methods for parsing settings related to window layout, files, options, table display, logger configurations, colors, clipboard formats, icons, and external plugins.

classes.name: DOMSettingsUnmarshaller
classes.description: Handles deserialization of XML settings into Settings objects for the RomRaider application.

methods.name: unmarshallSettings
methods.description: Main method to parse the root XML node and populate the Settings object based on child nodes.

methods.name: unmarshallWindow
methods.description: Parses window-related settings such as size, location, and maximized state.

methods.name: unmarshallFiles
methods.description: Parses file paths and definitions for ECU, image, and repository files.

methods.name: unmarshallOptions
methods.description: Parses various configuration options including warnings, debug mode, and UI preferences.

methods.name: unmarshallTableDisplay
methods.description: Parses table display properties such as font, cell size, and color settings.

methods.name: unmarshallColors
methods.description: Parses color settings for max, min, highlight, select, and borders.

methods.name: unmarshallLogger
methods.description: Parses logger configuration including protocol, window size, profile, and plugin ports.

methods.name: unmarshallColor
methods.description: Constructs a Color object from XML attribute values.

methods.name: unmarshallClipboardFormat
methods.description: Parses clipboard format settings, including header text for different table formats.

methods.name: unmarshallIcons
methods.description: Parses icon scale settings for editor and table icons.
